metadata.note: Source-bounded Kowloon and western New Territories open spaces. The Kowloon City and Wong Tai Sin supplements come from CEDD’s iB1000 service. Salisbury Garden and Tsim Sha Tsui Promenade are scoped to current shared ground support. Source sports are clipped clear of current building layouts and roads. Paths, access, paving, planting, benches, planters and surface finish are authored approximations. Nan Lian Garden reserves surveyed ponds and pavilions. Source dates do not establish current access or venue status.
